category_edits.rationale: Shorten causal context to floor(0.75 × current length), with a minimum of one interaction (128 → 96 by default). Existing truncation retains recent interactions chronologically, and saved maxlen metadata applies the same context during prediction. This may reduce stale-interest interference and recurrent computation while preserving the GRU architecture, readout, loss and optimizer.

change_summary: Reduce training and prediction context length by 25% across all four datasets through the existing shared maxlen and predictor metadata.
